subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Romance Scams
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Romance Scams.

hook.text: A woman sends $500,000 to a man she met online. They never met in person. He doesn't exist.

buildup.text: Romance scams build fake relationships over months to extract money from emotionally vulnerable victims.

discovery.text: The FTC reports romance scam losses exceeded $1.3 billion in 2022. Victims lose an average of $4,400.

twist.text: AI chatbots and deepfake video calls make romance scams more convincing than ever before.

climax.text: Romance scams exploit loneliness and trust. Victims are often too ashamed to report the crime.

punchline.text: $1.3 billion lost to fake love. Most victims stay silent.

quiz.question: How much was lost to romance scams in 2022?
